evidence.reflection: External read-only inspection of native UFunctions, UProperties and category enums
evidence.nativeUpgradeWeapon: UpgradeLevel is an increment; clamps to GetWeaponMaxLevel; updates owned info, applies effects and broadcasts; no material deduction in inspected native path
evidence.nativeUpgradeAccessory: UpgradeLevel is an increment; preserves entitlement rejection and per-item cap; refreshes equipped effects
evidence.gates: Weapon synchronization copies only the current owned category peak, capped by each item's native maximum and table size; plugin-side JHSY checks no longer block that copy. Normal active upgrades are unchanged. AccessoryLevelData bNeedInJHSY remains checked for every crossed accessory level using PBZTeleportSubsystem.IsInJhsy.
evidence.persistence: Mutates native inventory via game upgrade functions; relies on subsequent normal game save
evidence.observedFailure: 0.1.0 loaded and reached owned inventory, then stopped in Adapter.describe: ForEach is absent on a returned Lua array
evidence.returnedArrays: UE4SS cdbc0b66 LuaUObject.cpp converts returned arrays to 1-based Lua tables; struct elements are LocalUnrealParam wrappers. 0.1.1 uses ipairs plus element:get() for both weapon families
limitations: No upgrade execution or save/reload check
evidence.queueRepair: Pending batches no longer record an unchanged signature as complete; rejected items cannot skip later inventory entries.
evidence.observedInventory: 2026-10-31 external read: category 1 contains Tang 20, LuanYing 20 and RenOuQingTongJian 21; category 3 contains Long 20, ZhanMaBlade 20 and PoJun 21. Category 2 peak is 18. Native rows require JHSY for levels 21-31; the cycle-0 native cap is 30.
evidence.sameCategoryRepair: The previous plugin-side location gate returned 20 for same-category 20-to-21 copies outside JHSY. 0.1.2 now uses the already-owned weapon peak without that extra gate; grouping, per-item caps, locks and accessory gates remain. Runtime execution remains unverified.
